entry.conditional: SetParam writes BolbImageEnable to this+0x15EAD and BinaryImageEnable to this+0x15EAE, then immediately calls the corresponding SDK basic-parameter setter. ProcessOutput checks the same fields before publishing the SDK result images.

entry.boundary: The publication branches run after BlobNum and TotalArea. The flags also enter the SDK before Run. In the fixed direct-SDK sample, all four flag combinations preserve the result vector, including the count and area difference between default and explicit full-frame ROI.
